api_analysis.hypothesis: The custom pybind module registers functions but not as torch.ops operators. Verification expects torch.ops.cuda_extension.*, which requires registration into the torch.ops namespace via TORCH_LIBRARY. Current binding.cpp only applies simple pybind defs, so torch.ops.cuda_extension.* lookups fail with 'incompatible with the pybind module'.
evidence: source_checks.json errors: 'torch.ops.cuda_extension.conv_transpose_forward is incompatible with the pybind cuda_extension module' for all operators.
model_new.py calls these via torch.ops.cuda_extension.*, not via direct module attributes.
binding_registry.h only provides pybind module registration, no torch/library.h inclusion or TORCH_LIBRARY registration.
kernel files contain only raw CUDA kernels and launchers, no torch op registration.
changes: Add kernels/custom_ops_registration.cpp that includes torch/library.h and defines TORCH_LIBRARY(cuda_extension, m) with m.def for each operator, mapping to the existing Python binding functions.
No changes to CUDA kernels; the launchers are correct.
Expect torch.ops.cuda_extension.* to be available and verification to proceed to numerical checks.
